About Brillio 
 Brillio LLC is a fast-growing, pure-play Digital Transformation Solutions and Services company backed by Bain Capital private equity. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Silicon Valley, Brillio is focused on delivering design-led solutions for our customers. We are not an IT Services company trying to pivot and support the “next big thing.” As a digitally native company, everything we have done and will continue to do, will have this laser focus. Brillio delivers disruptive digital solutions across capabilities such as Design Thinking, Product Engineering, Data Analytics, Digital Front Office, and Digital Infrastructure. Our core values of Customer success, We Care, Entrepreneurial (mind set) and Excellence - drive everything that we do, from the very first day. 
 Brillio Romania 
 Brillio Romania is a dynamic and rapidly growing company with over 200 employees and offices in Cluj, Oradea, and Bucharest. With its fast-paced growth, the company has consistently demonstrated an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction. 
 At Brillio Romania, we know our success comes from the innovative contributions and brilliant work of our people. So, we make fostering a positive work environment our top priority. Employees at Brillio Romania not only thrive, but they also have the chance to build long and fulfilling careers, fostering a sense of stability and dedication that ultimately benefits both the company and our valued clients.
 Role: 
 AEM & React.js – Multiple Engineering Roles 
 Working Hours: 13:00 – 21:00 
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 We are looking for experienced AEM & React.js professionals to join our engineering teams across multiple roles. Depending on your experience, technical background, and career level, you may be considered for the position that best matches your profile.
 Open Roles 
AEM + React.js Engineer – Development
AEM + React.js Support Engineer – L2/L3
Senior AEM + React.js Engineer
AEM + React.js Technical Lead
 About the Roles 
 Our teams work on enterprise digital platforms built with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Java, React.js, APIs, and cloud technologies.
 The available positions cover different areas, from hands-on development and technical implementation to production support, troubleshooting, technical leadership, and continuous improvement.
 We are looking for engineers who enjoy working with modern technologies, solving complex technical challenges, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in an enterprise environment . 
 Responsibilities: 
 Depending on the role, you may be responsible for:
Developing and enhancing enterprise applications using AEM, Java, and React.js
Building and maintaining AEM Components, Templates, HTL/Sightly, Sling Models, Servlets, and OSGi services
Developing reusable and scalable React.js components using JavaScript/TypeScript
Integrating AEM and React applications with REST APIs and enterprise systems
Providing L2/L3 production support and resolving technical incidents within agreed SLAs
Troubleshooting AEM Author/Publish environments, Dispatcher, CDN, caching, replication, APIs, and frontend issues
Performing root cause analysis and implementing permanent fixes
Supporting deployments, releases, hotfixes, and CI/CD processes
Participating in code reviews, technical design, and solution discussions
Improving application performance, stability, security, and maintainability
For Senior/Lead roles: mentoring engineers, driving technical discussions, handling complex escalations, and collaborating with architects and other technical teams
 Technical Skills: 
Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
Java
React.js / JavaScript / TypeScript
AEM Components, Templates, HTL/Sightly
Sling Models, Servlets, OSGi, JCR
Content Fragments / Experience Fragments
REST APIs and enterprise integrations
AEM as a Cloud Service / Adobe Cloud Manager
Git, Maven, npm/yarn, CI/CD
Dispatcher, CDN, caching, and web performance
Production troubleshooting and root cause analysis
Monitoring and log analysis
 Nice to Have 
Headless / hybrid AEM experience
Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, or Adobe Experience Platform
AEM certification
ITIL knowledge
Experience with Splunk, New Relic, Dynatrace, or similar tools
Jira / ServiceNow
Agile / Scrum / SAFe
Experience working on large-scale, multi-market enterprise platforms
Knowledge of WCAG and web accessibility
